name: hide-actions
description: Hides Claude's tool-call rows in the VS Code chat while the Claude toolbar's view button asks for it.

pollMs.title: Bridge poll interval (ms)
pollMs.description: How often the mod re-reads the chat-view file that the Claude toolbar writes, in milliseconds. Lower follows the view button sooner. At least 100.

surfaces.title: Hide actions on
surfaces.description: Where tool-call rows hide while the view button says so: comma-separated surfaces from vscode, desktop, terminal, mobile.

alwaysShow.title: Always show these tools
alwaysShow.description: Tools whose rows stay visible while actions are hidden: comma-separated tool names, spelled exactly as Claude names them, such as AskUserQuestion, ExitPlanMode, TodoWrite.
